publisher: Department of Land and Real Estate Regulation
grain: one source row per project label, sector, district, unit type, rooms and quarter; mortgage registrations and mortgage-value modifications may both be included
limits: This is a dated, project-labelled quarterly unit-mortgage aggregate. It overlaps the separate mixed Ajman unit-disposition dataset and must not be added to it. The source description includes mortgage registration and mortgage-value modification, so count is not a count of unique loans or property sales. It does not provide individual mortgages, loan-to-value, transaction prices, project-site coordinates, or an all-UAE denominator. 2021Q2 is absent, and five rows have unknown room counts. Source names are not automatically joined to V48 project identities.
